annotations.title: Campaign-level negative keywords on Google Ads

description: The NEGATIVE KEYWORDS SET ON ONE GOOGLE ADS CAMPAIGN (campaign level), separate from an ad group's own negatives (add_google_ads_keywords negative:true) and from shared lists (manage_google_ads_negative_list). action list (default) | add (keywords) | remove (keywords or criterionIds from list) | replace (keywords: the WHOLE set afterwards, [] clears them; diffed against Google so unchanged ones keep their ids, sent in one atomic change). keywords are "text" or {text, matchType BROAD|PHRASE|EXACT}, default BROAD. Adding only stops ads showing and never asks. Removing one (or a replace that drops one) on a LIVE campaign lets that search spend again: show the user, then confirm:true. dryRun:true has Google check it. Read back from Google. Free.

confirm.description: true only after the user approved a change that can raise spend on a LIVE campaign

customerId.description: Google Ads account id, 10 digits; omit for the brand's selected default account

dryRun.description: true = Google validates it and nothing changes

keywords.description: keywords to add / remove, or the whole set for replace

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id when acting through one; omit otherwise
